about_the_game:
This is a short 3D action RPG where you play as a young girl venturing deep into a mysterious forest, battling cursed animals along the way. Through each encounter, she gradually confronts her own inner emotions. Immerse yourself in a quiet tale of escape and renewal, brought to life with dreamy visuals and a gentle soundtrack.

・A Fantastical World Inhabited by Spirits
Explore a mystical wilderness where spirits dwell and cursed animals roam. As the player, you'll journey through these enchanted lands, uncovering the story while facing off against corrupted creatures.

・Play as a Sword-Wielding Girl and Banish the Curse
Take control of a brave girl who uses sword techniques to fight off the cursed beasts. Combat is central to the gameplay, and each encounter pushes you deeper into the forest—and into the girl's own heart.

・A Compact, Repayable Experience
Designed for short play sessions, the game features frequent, fast-paced battles to keep things engaging. The challenge level is slightly high, but players can retry as many times as needed—offering a rewarding sense of growth and mastery.

Estimated Playtime: 20–30 minutes per playthrough
Save Feature: Not available (short-form experience)
Supported Controllers: Nintendo Switch Pro Controller / PlayStation 5 Dual Sense (recommended)
